dedupe_keys.name: bndes hub de projetos pipeline of infrastructure concessions and ppps structured by bndes brazil

description: The Hub de Projetos of Brazil's national development bank BNDES lists the infrastructure concessions and public-private partnerships that the bank helps federal, state and municipal governments to structure. The project page read on 2026-09-28 shows a filterable table for the third quarter of 2026 giving each project's name, sector, contract category, location and status (technical studies, public consultation, tender, auction or signed contract), with a statistics tab and a page per project; examples include regional water and sanitation blocks in Alagoas and Pará, solid waste in Amapá, the Angra 3 nuclear plant, public lighting PPPs in Canoas, Caruaru, Jaboatão and Joinville, the São Francisco river integration scheme, metro and urban mobility lots in São Paulo and Paraná, and hospital and school PPPs. Coverage is national. Access is free on the web; no licence is stated and no bulk download was seen. Caveats: the list covers only BNDES-structured projects, capacities and costs sit on project pages, and statuses change each quarter. It supports capacity planning and future network scenarios for Brazilian water, sanitation, waste, lighting and transport systems. Related records: data-bndes-mobilidade-brasil is BNDES's urban mobility dataset.
